summary: Contestants demonstrate essential spreadsheet skills by organizing, analyzing, and presenting data using spreadsheet tools. Participants design and format workbooks, build automated solutions with formulas and references, create charts, and apply styles and validation for professional reports. All work is completed on-site and uploaded electronically.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than ninety (90) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minute wrap-up
No more than fifty (50) minutes for certification test
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Design, format, and manage worksheets and workbooks using spreadsheet tools to organize, analyze, and present data accurately and efficiently
Develop formulas/functions to create automated spreadsheet solutions
Apply mixed, absolute, and relative cell references, including cross-sheet references
Create charts and organize data using outlines, groups, and subtotals to enhance reporting
Enhance spreadsheet usability and presentation by applying styles, validating data, auditing formulas, and customizing print options
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
Contestants may not enter Fundamental and Advanced Spreadsheet Applications in the same year.
This event may not be repeated.
